en: The set of all first coordinates (inputs) from the ordered pairs

question.en: Which of the following conditions must be satisfied for a relation to be classified as a function?
question.am: Which of the following conditions must be satisfied for a relation to be classified as a function?

en: Every element in the domain is paired with exactly one element in the range
Every element in the range must be equal to zero
The relation must only contain negative integers
No two distinct inputs can produce the same output value
am: Every element in the domain is paired with exactly one element in the range
Every element in the range must be equal to zero
The relation must only contain negative integers
No two distinct inputs can produce the same output value

explanation.en: Textbook definition (page 12): A function is a relation where each input in the domain maps to exactly one output in the range.
